footer.about: GS Gutters LLC is an owner-led, insured Wichita company founded by Nelson Galdamez. We do gutters, siding, painting, decks, floors, windows and doors.

why: People hire you for more than gutters. In your Google reviews you replaced siding, painted a house, installed five windows and a garage door, built a deck and hung gutters, and one customer wrote, “You need a job done make him your first and only call!”

Your website says gutters. The top of your homepage promises “Superior Gutter Solutions”, and siding, paint, decks, floors, windows and doors share one short page. Google reads a gutter company, and none of your 52 reviews appears on your site.
So we built a demo that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita at the very top, gives your bigger jobs a page each, and puts your reviews next to the work they describe.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how we fix it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn what you do.
problems: The top of your homepage says “Superior Gutter Solutions” and has no main headline, so siding, paint, decks, windows and doors never come up.
None of your 52 reviews is shown anywhere.
fixes: A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Every service listed, with a line on each.
Real reviews, each beside the work it describes.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Gutters
cards.why: Gutters are the work your customers praise most.
problems: Your gutters page has no main headline, so “gutter installation Wichita” has nothing to land on.
Installation, cleaning and screens get three paragraphs of general praise, and no customer says you did the work well.
fixes: A headline that says gutter installation, repair and cleaning in Wichita, KS.
A section for each gutter job, with reviews beside it.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Siding, Painting & Decks
cards.why: Siding, painting and decks are some of your biggest home jobs.
problems: Siding, painting, floors, decks, and windows and doors share one short page, so someone searching for a deck or siding in Wichita finds a single line.
Your gallery page is a heading and about 100 photos with no words, so Google reads nothing.
fixes: A page for siding, painting and decks in Wichita, KS, with a section for each.
Reviews from your siding, paint and deck jobs placed beside each one.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: The page where interest turns into a call.
problems: Your site opens on http:// without the padlock, and visitors fill out the form on it.
The form has no spam protection, and the email at the very top shows info@gsguttersllc.com but opens a Gmail address.
fixes: A call button in one tap, plus your address and the area you cover.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already say you are fair, fast and professional. On your onboarding call we confirm the full list of services with you.

onboardingQuestions: Nelson's full name and how he wants to be introduced. The site and reviews give "Nelson Galdamez"; the surname is not in a state record.
Years in business. The site says "over eight years of invaluable experience", but no founding year is confirmed. What can we say?
Insurance and licensing: the site says "as an insured company". Is there a license, certificate or BBB listing to show?
Hours: the old site footer says Monday to Saturday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Is that current? We left hours off until confirmed.
Email: the site footer shows info@gsguttersllc.com but the top-bar link opens a Gmail address. Which should we show?
Is 1243 N Poplar St open to customers, or should the address stay off the site?
Which towns within the 90-mile radius do they work in most, so we can name them?
Services to confirm: windows and doors (installed or only trimmed and painted), floors, interior painting, kitchen remodels (one review), soffit, fascia and rotted-wood repair.
Gutter details: seamless aluminum? Gutter screen brand? Any warranty on gutters, siding or decks?
Does the 10% veterans and retirees discount, and the free estimate, apply to every service?
Logo file, brand colors and photos of finished siding, decks and gutters.
